prose_chunks.text: These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.

attributes.description: Cookies necessary for the website to function
attributes.examples: setting privacy preferences, logging in, filling in forms

extracted_data.summary: The section explains that strictly necessary cookies are required for website functionality, are triggered by user actions, may be blocked or alerted by browser settings, and do not store personally identifiable information.

prose_chunks.text: These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages. If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these services may not function properly.

attributes.role: services added to the website pages

extracted_data.summary: The section explains that functional cookies improve website functionality and personalization, may be set by the website or third-party providers, and that disabling them may cause some services to not work properly.

prose_chunks.text: These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. All information these cookies collect is aggregated and therefore anonymous. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site, and will not be able to monitor its performance.

attributes.context: users whose movement and visits are tracked in aggregated, anonymous form

extracted_data.summary: The section explains that performance cookies are used to count visits and traffic sources, analyze page popularity and visitor movement, and monitor and improve website performance using aggregated, anonymous data.

prose_chunks.text: These cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites. They do not store directly personal information, but are based on uniquely identifying your browser and internet device. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.

attributes.role: set cookies and show relevant adverts

extracted_data.summary: The section explains that targeting cookies may be set by advertising partners to build interest profiles and display relevant ads on other sites, using browser and device identifiers rather than directly personal information.

prose_chunks.text: These cookies are set by a range of social media services that we have added to the site to enable you to share our content with your friends and networks. They are capable of tracking your browser across other sites and building up a profile of your interests. This may impact the content and messages you see on other websites you visit. If you do not allow these cookies you may not be able to use or see these sharing tools.

attributes.function: enable content sharing and tracking across sites

extracted_data.summary: The section explains that social media cookies enable sharing content through social platforms, can track browsing across other sites, and may affect the content and messages users see on other websites if the cookies are not allowed.
